Sir,
I have much pleasure in acknowledging the safe arrival of your thank offering for the [Hospital for Sick Children](/organisation/3) in Great Ormond Street. I am this morning forwarding it to the Assistant Secretary [Mr S Whitford](/person/1811), 4, Porter Street Leicester Square. I am sure from the particulars I learn from ladies constantly in the habit of visiting there that it is a most valuable and well conducted charity; and that your donation will be well bestowed.
With thanks for giving me so pleasant a commission, as well as for letting me know the cause
Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge
